task: unfiltered proteomics-only classwise DS-to-LE transfer with LE class context
notes: All combinations: two LE compounds per target class, or one when only two exist.
Add only their LE profiles to the original classwise training set; hold out all remaining LE compounds.
Every profile of test compounds is excluded from training. JH39 DS profiles stay excluded in both RNA arrangements.
Compare each arrangement with original zero-context predictions on the identical remaining test compounds.
Primary accuracy averages correctness across arrangements within each compound, then across 22 compounds.
This tests representative training coverage, not causal isolation of operator from chemistry or batch.
No significance filtering, hyperparameter selection, test-driven support choice or uncertainty evaluation.
